heroContent.headline: Live Freely, Retire Happily in Vietnam
heroContent.subtext: Discover Westerner Retirement Communities (WRCs) across Vietnam’s most stunning coastal cities and vibrant havens. Fully serviced residences, dedicated English-speaking concierge, healthcare navigation, and vibrant expat fellowship.

whyVietnam.title: Remarkable Cost of Living
whyVietnam.description: Enjoy upscale beachfront or city living, fine dining, domestic assistance, and leisurely pursuits at 50% to 65% lower expenses than Western metropolitan centers without compromising safety or luxury.

whyVietnam.title: Sun-Drenched Tropical Lifestyle
whyVietnam.description: Escape harsh winters with mild coastal sea breezes, year-round sunshine in Da Nang and Nha Trang, championship golf courses, pristine beaches, and relaxed open-air cafes.

whyVietnam.title: Warm Hospitality & Safe Society
whyVietnam.description: Vietnam consistently ranks among Southeast Asia’s safest, most welcoming countries. Savor fresh world-renowned cuisine, deep cultural heritage, and genuine warmth from local communities.

whyVietnam.title: Modern Healthcare & Wellness
whyVietnam.description: Benefit from JCI-accredited international hospitals, Western-trained physicians, prompt specialist appointments, and comprehensive wellness sanctuaries at fraction of Western out-of-pocket costs.

whyChooseUs.title: Dedicated Lifestyle Concierge
whyChooseUs.description: Every resident is paired with a fluent bilingual personal navigator who coordinates medical visits, bill payments, grocery deliveries, excursions, and daily conveniences.

whyChooseUs.title: Turnkey All-Inclusive Billing
whyChooseUs.description: One predictable monthly invoice covers accommodation, high-speed fiber internet, housekeeping, utilities allowance, clubhouse access, and lifestyle support.

whyChooseUs.title: Thriving Expat Fellowship
whyChooseUs.description: Regular social mixers, golf outings, book clubs, Vietnamese language workshops, and group culinary tours foster deep friendships from day one.

whyChooseUs.title: Seasonal Freedom & Fluidity
whyChooseUs.description: Whether spending 30 days testing the waters, escaping winter as a Snowbird, or putting down 12-month roots, transition seamlessly between our coastal hubs.

coreService.title: Wanderer’s All-Inclusive Living Inclusions
coreService.description: Every long-term stay is crafted to eliminate life’s mundane burdens so you can focus entirely on enjoying your retirement and passions.
coreService.utilityAllowanceNote: Includes monthly allowance up to $150 USD covering electricity, water, and cooling usage.
coreService.personalAssistant: Dedicated English-fluent Personal Assistant for appointments, translations, and lifestyle logistics.
coreService.cleaningSchedule: Professional housekeeping 3 times weekly with linen and towel refresh.
coreService.internetSpeed: High-speed dedicated 100 Mbps fiber-optic Wi-Fi with dual-band mesh coverage.
coreService.visaSupportNote: Complimentary advisory, renewal tracking, and processing assistance via accredited visa partners.
coreService.healthInsuranceSupportNote: Direct orientation with international expatriate healthcare brokers and hospital registration.
coreService.bankingSupportNote: Assistance setting up international debit cards, secure remittance channels, and local utility accounts.

additionalServices.title: In-Home Medical Care & Visiting Nurse
additionalServices.description: Arrangement of licensed visiting registered nurses for regular vital checks, medication management, and priority physician house calls.
additionalServices.priceLabel: From $45 / visit or tailored monthly plan
additionalServices.conditions: Provided via licensed partner international clinics in HCMC, Da Nang, and Nha Trang.

additionalServices.title: Private Full-Time Housekeeper & Chef
additionalServices.description: Dedicated culinary expert crafting nutritious dietary-tailored meals, farm-fresh market sourcing, and complete home care.
additionalServices.conditions: Vetted background checks, culinary testing, and English conversational basics.

additionalServices.title: Private Chauffeur & VIP Vehicle
additionalServices.description: On-demand airport transfers, weekly shopping excursions, and private day trips in premium air-conditioned sedans or SUVs.
additionalServices.conditions: Includes fuel, tolls, and licensed experienced English-familiar driver.

additionalServices.title: Bespoke Regional Discovery Tours
additionalServices.description: Exclusive weekend escapes to Hoi An ancient town, Ba Na Hills, Mekong Delta floating markets, and Dalat highlands.
additionalServices.conditions: All-inclusive private guide, luxury transport, and handpicked boutique lodging.

faqs.question: How do visas work for retirees and long-term stays in Vietnam?
faqs.answer: Vietnam provides straightforward tourist e-visas (up to 90 days with multiple entries) that can be seamlessly renewed with our concierge assistance. Furthermore, many retirees utilize business-sponsored visas, temporary residence cards (TRC), or investor options. Our accredited legal team coordinates all documentation, reminders, and border runs or in-country extensions for our residents.

faqs.question: What is the quality of medical facilities and emergency care?
faqs.answer: Vietnam’s major hubs host world-class JCI-accredited international hospitals including FV Hospital, Vinmec International Hospital, and Family Medical Practice. Medical staff speak fluent English and French, many having completed training in the US, Australia, or Europe. Out-of-pocket costs and international insurance premiums are typically 70% lower than in Western countries.

faqs.question: How do I manage money, banking, and currency transfers?
faqs.answer: You can comfortably use Western credit and debit cards (Visa/Mastercard) across Vietnam with zero hassle. In addition, our personal concierge assists in setting up local expat accounts, low-fee digital transfer channels (Wise, Remitly, bank wires), and automated bill clearance for utilities.

faqs.question: What is included in the monthly living package?
faqs.answer: All essential living costs: your fully furnished 2-bedroom executive residence, housekeeping three times a week, high-speed 100 Mbps fiber internet, utility allowance up to $150 USD/month, resort amenities (pool, clubhouse, gym), 24/7 security, and your dedicated English-speaking Personal Navigator.

faqs.question: Can I bring my spouse, partner, or pets?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our 2-bedroom residences are designed comfortably for couples. Vietnam is increasingly pet-friendly, with coastal parks and dedicated veterinarians. Our team assists with pet importation paperwork and airline transit guidelines.

faqs.question: How safe is Vietnam for international retirees and solo seniors?
faqs.answer: Vietnam is widely recognized as one of the safest destinations in Southeast Asia. Violent crime is exceptionally rare, and senior residents frequently walk along coastal esplanades and city quarters late into the evening with complete peace of mind. Vietnamese culture holds immense respect and kindness for elders.

faqs.question: Can I drive in Vietnam, or is it better to use concierge transport?
faqs.answer: International driver’s licenses can be converted into Vietnamese licenses with our team’s guidance. However, almost all of our residents prefer using on-demand private rides (Grab) or our dedicated Wanderer's concierge shuttle, completely eliminating driving stress for only $3–$6 across town.

faqs.question: Which international health insurance policies are accepted by local hospitals?
faqs.answer: Premier international insurers including Cigna Global, Allianz Care, Bupa, GeoBlue, and Aetna International have direct-billing agreements with top JCI-accredited hospitals in Vietnam (Vinmec, FV Hospital). Our team assists you in submitting claims and coordinating coverage.

faqs.question: Can I try a flexible month-to-month lease before committing to a full year?
faqs.answer: Yes, flexibility is a cornerstone of Wanderer's Journeys. You can begin with a 14-Day Exploratory Stay or 30-Day Living Trial, and smoothly transition to our Snowbird or 12-Month Retirement package without having to relocate or renegotiate leases.

faqs.question: How are US Social Security, Canadian CPP, or UK state pensions received in Vietnam?
faqs.answer: You can keep your existing bank account in your home country and receive your pension deposits via direct deposit as usual. Using low-fee global debit cards or services like Wise, funds can be spent or transferred to local Vietnamese accounts in seconds at real interbank exchange rates with zero penalty.
